snippets.description: Attribute #[CheckPermission]: repeatable, TARGET_METHOD, accepts enum-right (UnitEnum), list of route parameter names, abort-status and message
Middleware-artist: ReflectionMethod::getAttributes() reads action attributes, resolves arguments from route-parameters, calls Gate::allows(right->value, arguments) with abort_if
Example controller: index without arguments, show with one right, update with several duplicates #[CheckPermission] and various abort-statuses
